name: fix99_cave_roof_navmesh
verifies: fix-99 #2: no NPC NavMesh on the back of cave roofs — the Reddock cave (Dungeon_07) floor at (706.52, 33.9, -77.06) has NavMesh, the top of its roof inside the rock at 39.9 (where a varan was put back by the fall rule: 'fell 6,1 m: back to the NavMesh at (706.52, 39.98, -77.06)') has none; the same in the Kap Dun cave (Level_07 roof top 27.64 over the floor 15.29, goblins 'back to the NavMesh at (452.38, 27.86, -318.15)')
notes: CellNavMeshes bakes from the cells' MeshColliders; G3CollisionBuilder builds triangle colliders two-sided (_2s), so before fix-99 the reversed copy of every cave roof faced up and Recast made walkable NavMesh on it inside the rock (16 m of 'headroom' up to the landscape). G3.Player.NavFacingRules keeps per near-horizontal triangle only the copy facing like the object's render mesh (G3Cli collision navfacing: world 4.87 M pairs, 753 k ceiling back copies dropped, 70 k without a render match stay two-sided). Columns from G3Cli collision column x z.
